Leonida Map & Locations

GTA 6 is set in Leonida, Rockstar’s Florida-inspired state. These are the locations officially named by Rockstar — from neon Vice City to the swamps of Grassrivers.

Main City

Vice City

The glamour, hustle and greed of America embodied in one city. Neon Ocean Drive-style beaches, Art Deco hotels, clubs, and the pastel streets from the original Vice City — rebuilt at a far bigger scale.

Islands

Leonida Keys

A tropical archipelago of islands linked by bridges — Jason’s home base in the trailers. Boats, beach houses and laid-back life, with danger never far away.

Coastal Town

Port Gellhorn

A faded coastal strip of motels, boarded-up attractions and cheap thrills. Trailers show it as a grittier, run-down contrast to Vice City’s shine.

Industrial

Ambrosia

Home to the Ambrosia sugar refinery in Allied Crystal territory — industrial heartland where biker gangs and factory work shape the local story.

National Park

Mount Kalaga

A national park near Leonida’s northern border with wild animals, hiking trails and off-road country — a first for the series’ map variety.

Wetlands

Grassrivers

Swamps and wetlands full of gators and mud — the wild, unpredictable part of Leonida seen in Trailer 1’s airboat and wildlife shots.

Characters — Lucia & Jason

A crime duo in the Bonnie-and-Clyde mould: when things go sideways, they only have each other to rely on.

Lead

Lucia Caminos

Fresh out of Leonida Penitentiary at the start of Trailer 2. Raised to fight for her family, Lucia is committed to her plan no matter what it takes — and wants a good life for herself and her mother.

Lead

Jason Duval

Grew up around grifters and crooks, served in the army, and now works for local drug runners in the Keys. Meeting Lucia could be the best — or worst — thing to happen to him.

Supporting Cast

The People Around Them

Cal Hampton — Jason’s friend & conspiracy theorist. Brian Heder — veteran drug runner, Jason’s boss. Boobie Ike — Vice City legend turned businessman. Dre’Quan Priest — Only Raw Records founder. Real Dimez — rap duo & influencers. Raul Bautista — seasoned bank robber.

Vehicles Spotted in Trailers

Cars, Boats, Planes & More

Trailers show a huge vehicle mix returning and expanding: modern sports cars & supercars, classic muscle cars, lowriders, pickups, police cruisers & helicopters, speedboats & yachts, seaplanes, propeller planes, airboats for the swamps, dirt bikes, ATVs and bicycles. Expect GTA 5 favourites reimagined for Leonida plus all-new rides — the full vehicle list will be added here as it’s confirmed.

GTA 6 Cheat Codes — All 61 Cheats, Confirmed Codes & How to Unlock Them

Updated 23 Nov 2026: GTA 6 has 61 cheat codes on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S — and they work very differently from GTA 5. No cheat works until you finish the main story (all 91 missions). After the credits, a Cheats tab appears in the Progress Menu, and every cheat unlocks through its own challenge. 17 codes are public so far, cross-checked across Red Bull, Polygon, GameSpot, GamesRadar and KeenGamer, who played the released game. Rockstar has published no official list. The remaining codes are revealed inside the game's Cheats menu the moment you unlock them — so below you get every one of the 61 cheats with its exact unlock challenge, plus every confirmed code.

How to Enter a GTA 6 Cheat

1. Press Up on the D-Pad to open your phone.
2. PS5: hold L1 and press R1 · Xbox: hold LB and press RB.
3. Enter the cheat's D-Pad sequence (identical on PS5 and Xbox).
There are no phone-number cheats and no PC version at launch.

💰 The GTA 6 Money Cheat

The only money cheat in GTA 6 gives $250,000 and unlocks the moment you finish the story:

Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right

Note: saving is disabled while a cheat is active, so this cash never carries into a normal save.

⚠️ Before You Cheat

Activating any cheat disables saving for the rest of the session and blocks trophies / achievements. Save manually first, have your fun, then reload the clean save. Entering a code for a cheat you haven't unlocked yet does nothing — finish its challenge first.

How to Enter Cheats

🎮 PlayStation / Xbox

Press the buttons in order, quickly, during gameplay (not in pause). A “Cheat Activated” note appears above the mini-map. Enter again to switch some cheats off.

⌨️ PC

Press ~ (tilde) to open the console, type the PC word in CAPS, press Enter. Or dial the phone number on your character’s phone.

📱 In-Game Phone

Open the phone → Contacts → press Square (PS) / X (Xbox) to bring up the dial pad → enter the 1-999 number → dial. Works on all platforms.

GTA 5 Cheats PS5 & PS4 (PlayStation)

Button combos using Circle, Triangle, Square, X, L1, L2, R1, R2 — e.g. Invincibility: Right, X, Right, Left, Right, R1, Right, Left, X, Triangle. PS5 and PS4 use the same GTA 5 cheat codes; PS3 codes are largely the same combos.

GTA 5 Cheats Xbox Series X|S & Xbox One

Button combos using B, Y, X, A, LB, LT, RB, RT — e.g. Max Health & Armour: B, LB, Y, RT, A, X, B, Right, X, LB, LB, LB. Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and Xbox 360 share the same cheat set.

FAQ — GTA 6 & GTA 5 Cheats

Is there a GTA 5 money cheat?

No. There has never been a money cheat in GTA 5 story mode or GTA Online. Anyone selling one is scamming. Make money via story heists, stock market (Lester’s assassinations) and businesses.

Do cheats work in GTA Online?

No. All cheats on this page are for story mode / single player only. Using mods or cheats in GTA Online can get an account banned.

Do cheats disable trophies?

Yes — for that play session only. Save before using cheats, have fun, then reload / restart the game to earn Achievements & Trophies again.

When is GTA 6 releasing and on what platforms?

Rockstar’s announced date is 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. A PC version has not been announced for launch.

Are GTA 6 cheat codes out yet?

Yes. GTA 6 has 61 cheats on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, but none of them work until you finish the main story. After the credits, a Cheats tab appears in the Progress Menu and each cheat unlocks through its own challenge. 17 D-Pad codes are public so far — the full list with every unlock challenge is in the GTA 6 Cheats section above.

What is the GTA 6 money cheat code?

Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right — it gives you $250,000 and unlocks as soon as you finish the story. Enter it via the phone: Up on the D-Pad, hold L1 + R1 (PS5) or LB + RB (Xbox), then the sequence. Saving is disabled while cheats are active, so the cash does not carry into a normal save.

Why is my GTA 6 cheat code not working?

Almost always because that cheat is not unlocked yet. Codes do nothing until you finish the story AND complete that cheat's own challenge — check Progress Menu > Cheats to see what it still needs. Also make sure you are holding L1/LB while pressing R1/RB before entering the D-Pad sequence.

Are there GTA 6 cheats for PC?

No — GTA 6 launched on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only, and Rockstar has not announced a PC version. Any site selling "GTA 6 PC cheat codes" right now is running a scam.

Where is GTA 6 set?

In Leonida, Rockstar’s Florida-inspired state — including Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga National Park and the Grassrivers wetlands.

What is the GTA 5 invincibility (god mode) cheat?

PlayStation: Right, X, Right, Left, Right, R1, Right, Left, X, Triangle. Xbox: Right, A, Right, Left, Right, RB, Right, Left, A, Y. PC: PAINKILLER. Phone: 1-999-724-654-5537. Lasts 5 minutes per entry.

What is the GTA 5 helicopter cheat (Buzzard)?

PlayStation: Circle, Circle, L1, Circle, Circle, Circle, L1, L2, R1, Triangle, Circle, Triangle. PC: BUZZOFF. Phone: 1-999-289-9633. See the Vehicles filter in the cheat library for the Stunt Plane, Duster, Comet, Rapid GT, PCJ-600 and more spawn codes.

How much does GTA 6 cost? What is the GTA 6 price in India and the USA?

Rockstar has not announced an official GTA 6 price yet — not in India (₹), the USA ($) or anywhere else. Any exact price online today is unconfirmed. The official price will be added to the Price & Pre-Order section above as soon as Rockstar announces it.

Can I pre-order GTA 6 now?

As of 23 Nov 2026, GTA 6 pre-orders had not opened on the PlayStation Store or Xbox Store. Only pre-order from official stores or authorised retailers when they do — avoid sites asking for payment for GTA 6 pre-orders today.

Will GTA 6 come to PC? What are GTA 6 PC system requirements?

GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on 19 Nov 2026; no PC version or PC system requirements have been announced. Any GTA 6 PC download or requirements list circulating now is speculation, not official.

Is there a GTA 6 Trailer 3?

As of the last update here, Rockstar had released two official GTA 6 trailers — Trailer 1 (Dec 2023) and Trailer 2 (6 May 2025). Any Trailer 3 release will be added to the News feed above with its date the moment Rockstar publishes it.

Do GTA 5 cheats work on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S?

Yes. GTA 5's story-mode cheat codes work the same on PS5 as on PS4 (and on Xbox Series X|S as on Xbox One) — use the PlayStation or Xbox tab in the library above. Phone-number cheats work on every platform, including PC.

Who are Lucia and Jason in GTA 6?

Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval are GTA 6's two protagonists — a crime duo in Leonida whose story begins with Lucia leaving Leonida Penitentiary, as shown in Trailer 2. Full profiles are in the Characters section above.
